meta.name: Generative Angles (Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, Multiple Angles LoRA)
meta.licenseNote: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 is Apache-2.0 (Alibaba Qwen, 2025-12-23); the Multiple Angles LoRA is Apache-2.0 (fal, huggingface.co/fal/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Multiple-Angles-LoRA, read 2026-10-12); the Lightning LoRA is Apache-2.0 (lightx2v, 2026-01).
meta.notes: The LoRA authors' own ComfyUI graph (comfyui-workflow-multiple-angles.json in the model repo, read 2026-10-12): the Multiple Angles LoRA then the 4-step Lightning LoRA on the model (both at strength 1), ModelSamplingAuraFlow 3.1, CFGNorm, the picture scaled by FluxKontextImageScale into both TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus encoders and VAE-encoded as the latent, 4 steps euler/simple at CFG 1. The prompt is the LoRA's fixed vocabulary, `<sks> [azimuth] [elevation] [distance]` (8 × 4 × 3 = 96 cameras), built by `generate.angles` from rotation, tilt and zoom, so it gets no prompt format. Needs `qwen-image-edit-2511-multiple-angles-lora.safetensors` in ComfyUI/models/loras (the app ships no weights).
meta.creator: fal (LoRA), Alibaba Qwen
meta.description: Moves the camera around the subject: 8 directions, 4 heights, 3 distances
